description: Create detailed executable steps for a single WBS work item via the thinking model. One model call per work item.
embedding_description: Create detailed executable steps for one work item in a WBS outline. Produces numbered steps with process keys, arguments, and sub-steps. Uses the thinking_artifact profile with the wbs_detail context loader. Repeated per work item in the outline.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Work item detail with executable steps
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The work item detail has been created. Continue to the next work item or proceed to assembly.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Creating WBS work item detail. create_wbs_work_item_detail accepts {outline_id, wbs_id, item_number, item_key, directive, support_articles}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. MissingDependency: outline, manifest, or sketch section not found. StorageError: knowledge base write failed.
